title: Aspen Beach House
meta_description: Private Pool, Walk To Grayton Beach Access- Aspen Beach House
description_expanded: Description: Aspen Beach House by Royal Destinations Location: Grayton Beach Address: 299 Defuniak Street Details: Aspen Beach House is a spacious Grayton Beach retreat offering approximately 2,794 square feet of interior living space and plenty of room for families and groups to enjoy the best of 30A. Accommodating up to 12 guests, this four-bedroom, five-bath home features multiple indoor and outdoor gathering spaces, a private heated pool, and a convenient location just a five-minute stroll from the beach and the heart of Grayton Beach. Inside, hardwood floors, 10-foot ceilings, and a beautifully equipped kitchen create a comfortable setting for gathering. The second-floor living area opens to covered balconies, including a screened balcony with outdoor dining, while the third-floor den and wet bar provide an additional space to relax. Outside, enjoy the private pool, open patio, outdoor shower, and both gas and charcoal grills. Whether you're spending the day at the beach, relaxing poolside, or exploring the laid-back charm of Grayton Beach, Aspen Beach House offers an ideal home base for your 30A vacation. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Approximately 0.3 Mile / 5-Minute Walk -Distance to Downtown Grayton Beach: Approximately 0.3 Mile / 5-Minute Walk -Parking Spaces: (1) in Carport and (4) in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 10, Bar Seating for 5, Bistro Seating for 2, Screened Balcony Dining for 6 -Coffee Maker Available: Keurig + Drip Coffee Maker -Private Heated Pool: 21’ x 9’ (3’-5’ Depth)* -Covered and Screened Balconies -Open Patio -Outdoor Shower -Outdoor Gas Grill *Pool heat is available for an additional fee and must be arranged prior to arrival. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 4 Bedrooms / 5 Baths Ground Floor: -Full Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Pool Area Second Floor: -Bedroom 1: Queen Bed with Detached Full Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area / Laundry Room -Covered Balconies -Screened Balcony with Dining for 6 Third Floor: -Bedroom 2 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Tub, Separate Shower) and Covered Balcony -Bedroom 3: (2) Queen Beds with Private Bath (Tub, Separate Shower, Double Vanity) -Bedroom 4 (Bunk Room): (2) Twin/Twin Bunks with Detached Full Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Den -Wet Bar with Mini Refrigerator -Covered and Screened Balconies Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
